tone.notes: Tilly's voice, calm delivery: hook names the place, facts as discoveries, the ocean as the catch, one 'Okay, review time', spoken rating. Fits 13+.

visuals.notes: New illustrated style matching the reference: flat 2D vector animation, deep blues and violets, glowing white ice, Saturn huge in the sky. Tilly stands on the ice of Enceladus in a mustard spacesuit; her gloved hand reaches toward a tiger-stripe crack; ice jets rise into space; the spray drifts into Saturn's E ring. Every clip scanned frame by frame: Veo had inserted an invented presenter or stray hands in two voice-over clips; both were regenerated and the remaining stray frames fall outside the used segments. No burned-in text.

character.notes: Drawn Tilly keeps the approved face: dark curly hair, freckles, thick brows; consistent mustard suit with red shoulder stripes and a clear bubble helmet. Calm, natural poses (standing, shading her visor once, small hand movements). Every clip's audio was transcribed and says its exact line.

learnings: style: illustrated (flat 2D vector) with the photo references keeps Tilly recognisable as a drawn character and looks like a modern animated space poster.

Veo invents a presenter (or hands) in voice-over shots; say 'no people, no faces and no presenter anywhere in the picture' in the place and 'the narration is a voice-over and nobody is ever shown' in the action.
Without the film grade, renders take ~12 minutes instead of 36-44.
